description: Quantum tunneling (Josephson-style) through a hexagonal honeycomb geometry -- the bee's geometry. The model reuses the measured per-link tunneling law of josephson-membrane v0.3.0 (each barrier link contributes one factor (1 - h)) and the honeycomb geometry of symmetry-entropy (6 neighbours, 120-degree angles, bipartite vertex lattice, Hales efficiency), and extends them: a 60-degree turn costs a factor, the critical current scales with the number of parallel hexagon-edge paths, and the honeycomb's symmetry axis changes the transmission. Synthetic and classical; no real quantum measurement is claimed.
title: Bee Geometry Tunneling
